title: 第496章 意外的遭遇第495章 铜门城离去
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 林鬼操控着法杖，在荒原边缘的一片低矮丘陵间缓缓降落。
队伍跟着落地。
艾尔维亚从法杖上跳下来，拍了拍衣袍上的尘土。
摩根拄着法杖来到他们身边。
塞德里克和弗里曼各自放下沉重的行李袋，活动了一下肩膀。
休利特站在外围，目光扫过四周，确认安全。
林鬼收起法杖，站定，目光在几个人身上扫了一圈。
“就在这里分开吧。”
他看向休利特，从怀里取出一个包裹递过去。
是艾尔维亚给他的那个邮差包。
“里面的信，麻烦休利特大人帮我送到。”
“这对我很重要。”
休利特接过邮差包，低头看了一眼。
包裹鼓鼓囊囊的，里面塞满了泛黄的信件。
封面上有的字迹已经模糊了，有的还清晰可辨。
收信人的地址都集中在四个地方。
龙骨城、白崖城、守望堡、枯木镇。
想起挂在邮局外面的送信路线图。
想起在好奇之下，塞德里克询问艾尔维亚关于邮局的事情，以及林鬼对当地大贵族出手的原因。
他抬起头，看着林鬼，表情有些复杂。
如今已经是不死烈阳的身份，全联盟的商会和贵族都想巴结上来的新贵，却还专注着送这些流民的信。
休利特低笑了一声。
“以骑士之名，我会送到他们手里的。”
他把邮差包挎在肩上，朝林鬼点了点头。
交代完信件的事情，林鬼的目光越过休利特，落在了旁边那个黑发的身影上。
艾琳。
她没有站在对面，而是站在他们身边。
法杖握在手里，表情平静，似乎从一开始就没打算往休利特那个方向走。
“艾琳小姐，你是打算和我们一起？”
艾琳点了点头。
“我的魔力能给你提供帮助。”
“而且，你们到了千塔也需要一个本地人为你们提供协助，我很适合。”
林鬼看着她，沉默了片刻。
“好不容易从那逃出来，你确定要回去？”
“而且如今你也是不死烈阳的一员，消息很快就会传到千塔那边。”
“如果你跟着我们过去，很可能会被罗斯家族因此做文章。”
他顿了一下。
“还是说，你想要……龙王回归？”
艾琳歪了歪头，黑色的眼眸里满是困惑。
“龙王是什么？”
林鬼尴尬地咳嗽了一声。
“咳咳……总之，你回去的话，会被罗斯家族奉为座上宾，随后想尽办法将你留下。”
“你确定，还要和我们一起？”
“而且其实我以前也在千塔滞留过一段时间。”
content_en:
Lin Gui controlled the staff and slowly landed among the low hills on the edge of the wasteland.
The team followed and landed.
Alvia jumped down from the staff and patted the dust on her robe.
Morgan came to them with his staff.
Cedric and Freeman each put down their heavy duffle bags and stretched their shoulders.
Hewlett stood on the outside, scanning the surroundings to confirm safety.
Lin Gui put away his staff, stood still, and glanced around several people.
"Let's separate here."
He looked at Hewlett, took out a package from his arms and handed it over.
It was the messenger bag that Alvia gave him.
"Please deliver the letter inside, Lord Hewlett, for me."
"This is important to me."
Hewlett took the messenger bag and glanced down.
The package was bulging and filled with yellowing letters.
Some of the writing on the cover has been blurred, while others are still legible.
The recipients' addresses are concentrated in four places.
Dragon Bone City, White Cliff City, Watch Castle, Deadwood Town.
Reminds me of the mail delivery route map hanging outside the post office.
Recalling that out of curiosity, Cedric asked Alvia about the post office and the reason why the Lin Kuei took action against the local nobles.
He raised his head and looked at Lin Gui with a complicated expression.
Now that he has become the Immortal Sun, all the chambers of commerce and nobles in the alliance want to curry favor with the upstarts, but they are still focused on sending letters to these refugees.
Hewlett chuckled.
"In the name of the knight, I will deliver it to them."
He slung his messenger bag over his shoulder and nodded to Lin Kuei.
After explaining the matter of the letter, Lin Gui looked past Hewlett and fell on the black-haired figure next to him.
Erin.
Instead of standing across from them, she stood beside them.
He held the staff in his hand with a calm expression, as if he had no intention of going in Hewlett's direction from the beginning.
"Miss Eileen, do you plan to come with us?"
Erin nodded.
"My magic can help you."
"Besides, you also need a local to assist you when you arrive at Thousand Towers. I am very suitable."
Lin Gui looked at her and was silent for a moment.
"You finally escaped from there, are you sure you want to go back?"
"And now that you are also a member of the Immortal Fierce Sun, the news will soon reach the Thousand Towers."
"If you follow us there, it's likely that the Ross family will make a fuss about it."
He paused.
"Or do you want...the Dragon King to return?"
Erin tilted her head, her black eyes filled with confusion.
"What is the Dragon King?"
Lin Gui coughed awkwardly.
"Ahem... In short, if you go back, you will be treated as a guest by the Ross family, and they will try their best to keep you here."
"Are you sure you want to stay with us?"
"And actually, I was stranded in Thousand Towers for a while before."
